programme.title: Tastes Like Home
programme.desc: One thing Savina cannot find in Oregon is a traditional Irish breakfast. Thankfully for Savina, Jacinta has shared their family's secret recipes for making an Irish breakfast with Catherine, who travels to Oregon to surprise Savina.

programme.title: Chuck and the First Peoples' Kitchen
programme.desc: Chuck visits Norma Condo, from the Mi'kmaq community of Gesgapegiac in Eastern Quebec who invites him to experience lobster fishing with Jeremy Jerome and crew. Back on the beach, Norma shares her traditional cooking techniques.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.sub-title: Greek Yogurt for Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner
programme.desc: At a local Athenian purveyor, Diane enjoys a true Greek classic: yogurt with honey. In the mountains of the Peloponnese, we will visit an artisanal producer of Greek yogurt, and in the kitchen, Diane will illustrate yogurt's versatility.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: On this culinary odyssey to Lefkada, Diane discovers Greece's tastiest lentils, rosewater vinegar, and the art of embroidery. Back in her kitchen, Diane prepares a bevy of flavorful dishes that are indicative of Ionian cuisine.

programme.title: Ross Kemp: Shipwreck Treasure Hunter
programme.desc: Continuing his adventure in Scapa Flow, Ross plunges down to the German Warship SMS Karlsruhe where he discovers the cause of its demise. The answer leads him 600 miles away to the wreck of an experimental 1920s submarine aircraft carrier.

programme.title: The Silk Road
programme.desc: Begin in Iran's Silk Road office where it is made clear that Iran has a goal of linking all countries along the illustrious road together. Then, high above sea level, explore the ruins of Hassan-i Sabbah fortress, the hideout of a movement known as "Hashshashins," essentially drug smoking assassins.

programme.title: The Silk Road
programme.desc: Some used to say Samarkand in central Uzbekistan was the center of the world. Follow the ancient "Royal Road" to the city associated with the great Turco-Mongol warrior Timur, visit his mausoleum, and learn about the imposing public square of Registan with the help of a local historian.

programme.title: The Silk Road
programme.desc: Enter the city that once was the core of the entire Silk Road in Persia: Tabriz, Iran. Find your way into the city's bazaar, the finest in the country, and wander through its 22-mile labyrinth. Also, meet Dr. Faribouz Esmaeli, the heart of this architectural gem, who oversaw its restoration.

programme.title: Grannies on Safari
programme.desc: Ottawa was once a central trading post thanks to the Ottawa River system. Now, it is the capital of Canada. Visit historic Parliament Hill, tour Rideau Hall, and sail along the pristine Ottawa River. Discover a prairie atop the Canadian War Museum, and cook with a Master Chef at the Le Cordon Blue.

programme.title: Smart Travels with Rudy Maxa
programme.desc: We can jet to Europe in a day and visit four cities in less than a week. It's great to take your time but sometimes you only have a day to visit. How can you be part of the international jet set and still get a taste of "old" Europe?

programme.title: Smart Travels with Rudy Maxa
programme.desc: With world-class cultural sites, dynamic new architecture and unstoppable energy, Berlin is a city on the move. We visit the museums - the ancient treasures of the Pergamon and the Egyptian museum, German Expressionism at the Neue Nationalgalerie and the newly designed Jewish Museum.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: London, England: In London, Tony attempts to dispel the myth that all English food is disgusting and over-boiled. Tony tries Nose to Tail Eating, explores traditional fare at Pie and Mash Shoppes, and then visits a predominantly Indian community.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Arcachon, France: Here, Bourdain first learned to love food as a child. Returning for a trip down memory lane, Tony enjoys childhood staples, including steak frites, gaufres (waffles), soupe de pecheur (fisherman's soup) and fresh oysters.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Down Under: The Wild West of Cooking
programme.desc: Melbourne, Australia boasts hard-living, good-natured, and eccentric lovers of food - Tony's kind of people. In search of the outlaws of food, Tony explores a pasteurization-free cheese factory, and an old-world cured jamon workshop.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Tony returns to his beloved Hanoi, Vietnam to visit his friend, Linh, for the Vietnamese lunar New Year holiday of Tet. Together they enjoy the holiday and indulge in all the exotic delicacies Vietnamese culture offers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: New York, NY and Provincetown, MA: Experience the formative moments of Tony's career as he revisits his first job, the culinary institute that taught him the basics, a normal workday at Les Halles Brasserie, and his mysterious mentor, Bigfoot.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Mekong River, Vietnam: On the river, Tony drinks a lot of Mekong moonshine with the welcoming owners of a duck farm. Although seduced by his Vietnam experience, Tony is not sure the royal dish Birds Nest Soup is all its cracked up to be.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Anthony travels to Tokyo, where he begins in the Tsujiki market and then is introduced to techniques in preparing edomae sushi. He also learns the diets of Sumo wrestlers.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.sub-title: The Cook Who Came in From the Cold

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Tony embarks on a pilgrimage to Sydney, Australia so he may indulge in a meal made by one of the world's best chefs - Tetsuya Wakuda.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Scotland: Beginning in Glasgow, Tony experiences the heart-clogging glory of deep fried pizza, deep fried mars bars, and deep fried pickled eggs! Moving on to more traditional fare, Tony tastes haggis and learns to hunt and fish for his food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Portugal & Southwest France: Visiting his boss's family farm, Tony helps slaughter and feast on a pig the family has been fattening all year. Then, Tony heads to France to experience the rich delights of a foie gras farm.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Join Tony on his quest to characterize the perfect bar in New York City. Discover the importance of a maniacal bartender, the proper chemical makeup of drinks, the joys of seedy dive-bars, and the need for late-night snacks.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Cambodia: With a friend along for the ride, Tony travels to Phnom Penh, Cambodia, where he explores a food culture that is both pleasing to the palette and slightly frightening.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
